name: Weekly active users (WAU) — last 26 weeks
description: WAU by week for core app; excludes internal domains.

native.query:
select date_trunc('week', e.occurred_at) as week, count(distinct e.user_id) as wau
from app_events e
join users u on u.id = e.user_id
where e.occurred_at >= now() - interval '26 weeks'
  and u.email not ilike '%@acme.local%'
group by 1
order by 1

name: Signups by acquisition channel (last 90 days)
description: Daily signups grouped by utm_source / utm_medium.

native.query:
select date_trunc('day', u.created_at) as day,
       coalesce(nullif(u.utm_source,''),'(direct)') as source,
       count(*) as signups
from users u
where u.created_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
group by 1,2
order by 1,3 desc

name: MRR bridge — new, expansion, churn
description: Monthly recurring revenue movements from Stripe subscriptions.

native.query:
with m as (
  select date_trunc('month', s.event_time) as month,
         s.customer_id,
         sum(s.mrr_delta_cents)/100.0 as mrr_delta
  from stripe_mrr_deltas s
  where s.event_time >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '12 months'
  group by 1,2
)
select month,
       sum(case when mrr_delta > 0 then mrr_delta else 0 end) as gross_add,
       sum(case when mrr_delta < 0 then -mrr_delta else 0 end) as churn
from m
group by 1
order by 1

name: Support backlog by priority
description: Open Zendesk tickets by priority and age bucket.

native.query:
select t.priority,
       case
         when now() - t.created_at < interval '2 days' then '0-2d'
         when now() - t.created_at < interval '7 days' then '3-7d'
         when now() - t.created_at < interval '30 days' then '8-30d'
         else '30d+'
       end as age_bucket,
       count(*) as tickets
from zendesk_tickets t
where t.status in ('new','open','pending')
group by 1,2
order by 1,2

name: Latency p95 by endpoint
description: p95 request latency over last 24h for top endpoints.

native.query:
select r.route,
       percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by r.duration_ms) as p95_ms,
       count(*) as requests
from api_requests r
where r.started_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  and r.status_code < 500
group by 1
having count(*) > 200
order by p95_ms desc
limit 20

name: Top customers by trailing 30d revenue
description: Net revenue by customer over the last 30 days (refund-adjusted).

native.query:
select c.name as customer,
       sum(ch.amount_cents - coalesce(r.amount_cents,0))/100.0 as net_revenue
from stripe_charges ch
join customers c on c.stripe_customer_id = ch.customer_id
left join stripe_refunds r on r.charge_id = ch.id
where ch.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
  and ch.paid = true
group by 1
order by 2 desc
limit 25

name: Activation funnel — signup to first project
description: Cohort funnel for last 60 days of signups.

native.query:
with s as (
  select id as user_id, created_at from users
  where created_at >= now() - interval '60 days'
), p as (
  select distinct owner_user_id as user_id from projects
), i as (
  select distinct user_id from integrations where status='connected'
)
select
  count(*) as signups,
  count(p.user_id) as created_project,
  count(i.user_id) as connected_integration
from s
left join p on p.user_id = s.user_id
left join i on i.user_id = s.user_id

name: SQL: Failed webhook deliveries (last 7 days)
description: Investigate providers/timeouts for webhook failures.

native.query:
select w.provider,
       w.http_status,
       w.error_code,
       count(*) as failures
from webhook_deliveries w
where w.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
  and w.success = false
group by 1,2,3
order by failures desc

name: Inventory turns — warehouse summary
description: Monthly inventory turns by warehouse (NetSuite).

native.query:
select date_trunc('month', m.posted_at) as month,
       m.warehouse_code,
       sum(m.cogs_amount) as cogs,
       avg(m.on_hand_value) as avg_inventory_value,
       case when avg(m.on_hand_value)=0 then null
            else sum(m.cogs_amount)/avg(m.on_hand_value) end as turns
from netsuite_inventory_monthly m
where m.posted_at >= now() - interval '18 months'
group by 1,2
order by 1,2

name: Pipeline coverage (next 2 quarters)
description: Open opportunities by stage and close quarter.

native.query:
select o.close_quarter,
       o.stage,
       sum(o.amount) as pipeline_amount,
       count(*) as opps
from salesforce_opportunities o
where o.is_closed = false
  and o.close_date >= date_trunc('quarter', now())
  and o.close_date < date_trunc('quarter', now()) + interval '6 months'
group by 1,2
order by 1,2

name: NPS distribution (last 180 days)
description: Promoters/passives/detractors split and average score.

native.query:
select
  case when s.score >= 9 then 'promoter'
       when s.score >= 7 then 'passive'
       else 'detractor' end as bucket,
  count(*) as responses,
  avg(s.score) as avg_score
from nps_surveys s
where s.submitted_at >= now() - interval '180 days'
group by 1
order by 1

name: Cohort retention — week 0 to 12
description: Weekly retention by signup cohort; excludes bots.

native.query:
with cohort as (
  select id as user_id,
         date_trunc('week', created_at) as cohort_week
  from users
  where created_at >= now() - interval '20 weeks'
    and is_bot = false
), activity as (
  select user_id, date_trunc('week', occurred_at) as act_week
  from app_events
  where occurred_at >= now() - interval '20 weeks'
  group by 1,2
)
select c.cohort_week,
       (extract(epoch from (a.act_week - c.cohort_week))/604800)::int as week_n,
       count(distinct a.user_id) as active_users
from cohort c
join activity a on a.user_id = c.user_id
where a.act_week >= c.cohort_week
group by 1,2
having (extract(epoch from (a.act_week - c.cohort_week))/604800)::int <= 12
order by 1,2

name: Incidents by service (last 30 days)
description: PagerDuty incidents grouped by service and severity.

native.query:
select i.service_name,
       i.severity,
       count(*) as incidents
from pagerduty_incidents i
where i.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
group by 1,2
order by incidents desc

name: Query cache hit rate
description: Metabase query cache hits/misses from audit log.

native.query:
select date_trunc('hour', a.started_at) as hour,
       sum(case when a.cache_hit then 1 else 0 end)::float / count(*) as hit_rate,
       count(*) as runs
from mb_audit_query_runs a
where a.started_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
group by 1
order by 1

name: DBT model freshness — critical models
description: Latest dbt source/model freshness check results.

native.query:
select f.model_name,
       f.status,
       f.max_loaded_at,
       f.generated_at,
       f.error
from dbt_freshness_results f
where f.severity = 'error'
order by f.generated_at desc
limit 50

name: Churned customers — reasons (CSM notes)
description: Closed-lost reasons for churned accounts in last 6 months.

native.query:
select o.loss_reason,
       count(*) as accounts
from salesforce_opportunities o
where o.is_closed = true
  and o.is_won = false
  and o.type = 'Renewal'
  and o.closed_date >= now() - interval '6 months'
group by 1
order by accounts desc

name: Billing failures — retries remaining
description: Stripe invoices in past 14d with payment failures & retry count.

native.query:
select i.customer_id,
       i.id as invoice_id,
       i.attempt_count,
       i.next_payment_attempt,
       i.collection_method,
       i.status
from stripe_invoices i
where i.created_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
  and i.status in ('open','uncollectible')
  and i.attempted = true
order by i.attempt_count desc, i.created_at desc
limit 200

name: Feature usage — export actions
description: Exports by format and surface (dashboard/card/api) last 30d.

native.query:
select e.export_format,
       e.surface,
       count(*) as exports
from export_events e
where e.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
group by 1,2
order by exports desc

name: Uptime SLO — last 28 days
description: Availability SLO from synthetic checks (99.9% target).

native.query:
select date_trunc('day', c.checked_at) as day,
       1.0 - (sum(case when c.success then 0 else 1 end)::float / count(*)) as availability
from synthetic_checks c
where c.checked_at >= now() - interval '28 days'
  and c.check_name = 'api-health'
group by 1
order by 1

name: AR aging summary
description: Accounts receivable aging buckets by customer.

native.query:
select a.customer_name,
       sum(case when a.days_past_due between 0 and 30 then a.balance else 0 end) as d0_30,
       sum(case when a.days_past_due between 31 and 60 then a.balance else 0 end) as d31_60,
       sum(case when a.days_past_due between 61 and 90 then a.balance else 0 end) as d61_90,
       sum(case when a.days_past_due > 90 then a.balance else 0 end) as d90_plus
from netsuite_ar_aging a
group by 1
order by (d90_plus) desc

name: Experiment results — checkout copy A/B
description: Conversion by variant for experiment exp_checkout_copy_2026_06.

native.query:
select r.variant,
       count(*) filter (where r.event='view') as views,
       count(*) filter (where r.event='purchase') as purchases,
       (count(*) filter (where r.event='purchase'))::float / nullif(count(*) filter (where r.event='view'),0) as conversion
from experiment_events r
where r.experiment_key = 'exp_checkout_copy_2026_06'
  and r.occurred_at >= now() - interval '45 days'
group by 1
order by 1

name: Data quality — duplicate emails
description: Potential duplicate users by normalized email hash.

native.query:
select lower(trim(email)) as email_norm,
       count(*) as users,
       min(created_at) as first_seen,
       max(created_at) as last_seen
from users
where email is not null
group by 1
having count(*) > 1
order by users desc, last_seen desc
limit 100

name: Card runtime percentiles — last 7 days
description: p50/p95/p99 execution time by card_id from integration logs.

native.query:
select a.metabase_card_id,
       percentile_cont(0.50) within group (order by a.duration_ms) as p50_ms,
       percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by a.duration_ms) as p95_ms,
       percentile_cont(0.99) within group (order by a.duration_ms) as p99_ms,
       count(*) as runs
from integration_card_runs a
where a.started_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
  and a.status = 'success'
group by 1
having count(*) >= 10
order by p95_ms desc
limit 50

name: Customer health score — overview
description: Composite health score by account with latest CSM update.

native.query:
select h.account_name,
       h.health_score,
       h.risk_level,
       h.last_csm_touch_at
from customer_health_snapshots h
where h.snapshot_date = (select max(snapshot_date) from customer_health_snapshots)
order by h.health_score asc
limit 200

name: Refund rate by plan
description: Refunds as % of charges by pricing plan over last 90 days.

native.query:
with charges as (
  select p.plan_name, sum(ch.amount_cents) as cents
  from stripe_charges ch
  join pricing_plans p on p.id = ch.plan_id
  where ch.created_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
  group by 1
), refunds as (
  select p.plan_name, sum(r.amount_cents) as cents
  from stripe_refunds r
  join stripe_charges ch on ch.id = r.charge_id
  join pricing_plans p on p.id = ch.plan_id
  where r.created_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
  group by 1
)
select c.plan_name,
       coalesce(r.cents,0)::float / nullif(c.cents,0) as refund_rate
from charges c
left join refunds r using(plan_name)
order by refund_rate desc

name: OAuth token refresh failures
description: Auth refresh failures grouped by provider and error type.

native.query:
select a.provider,
       a.error_type,
       count(*) as failures,
       max(a.occurred_at) as last_seen
from auth_refresh_failures a
where a.occurred_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
group by 1,2
order by failures desc

name: Deprecated endpoints — traffic share
description: Requests hitting deprecated routes over last 14 days.

native.query:
select r.route,
       count(*) as requests,
       count(*)::float / sum(count(*)) over () as traffic_share
from api_requests r
where r.started_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
  and r.route in ('/v1/legacy/search','/v1/legacy/export','/v1/legacy/users')
group by 1
order by requests desc

name: Archived: 2025 Q4 board metrics snapshot
description: Frozen snapshot used for Q4 board deck; do not modify.

native.query: select * from board_kpi_snapshots where snapshot_key = '2025Q4'

-- temporary debug; removed
select u.id, u.email, m.merged_into_user_id
from users u join user_merges m on m.user_id=u.id
where u.email ilike '%@gmail.com'

name: On-call load — pages per engineer
description: Pager count per primary responder over last 8 weeks.

native.query:
select p.primary_responder as engineer,
       count(*) as pages
from pagerduty_incidents p
where p.created_at >= now() - interval '8 weeks'
  and p.urgency = 'high'
group by 1
order by pages desc

name: Warehouse pick errors — top SKUs
description: Pick/pack exceptions by SKU for last 30 days.

native.query:
select e.sku,
       count(*) as exceptions,
       sum(case when e.exception_type='wrong_item' then 1 else 0 end) as wrong_item
from wms_pick_exceptions e
where e.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
group by 1
order by exceptions desc
limit 30

name: Rate limited requests — by API key
description: 429s grouped by api_key_id over last 72 hours.

native.query:
select r.api_key_id,
       count(*) as rate_limited,
       max(r.started_at) as last_seen
from api_requests r
where r.started_at >= now() - interval '72 hours'
  and r.status_code = 429
group by 1
order by rate_limited desc

name: Partner leads — conversion to opportunity
description: Lead source=Partner; conversion rate to opp within 30 days.

native.query:
with leads as (
  select id, created_date
  from salesforce_leads
  where lead_source = 'Partner'
    and created_date >= now() - interval '6 months'
), opps as (
  select l.id as lead_id
  from leads l
  join salesforce_opportunities o on o.converted_from_lead_id = l.id
  where o.created_date <= l.created_date + interval '30 days'
)
select count(*) as partner_leads,
       count(opps.lead_id) as converted,
       count(opps.lead_id)::float / nullif(count(*),0) as conversion_rate
from leads
left join opps on opps.lead_id = leads.id

name: Archived: Legacy GA UA sessions
description: Old Universal Analytics sessions report retained for audit.

native.query:
select date_trunc('day', s.date) as day, sum(s.sessions) as sessions
from ga_ua_sessions_daily s
where s.date >= '2024-01-01'
group by 1
order by 1

name: Deleted: snowflake cost spike deep dive
description: Superseded by tagged cost dashboards; removed per cleanup.

native.query:
select warehouse_name, sum(credits_used) as credits
from snowflake_warehouse_metering
where start_time >= '2026-02-01' and start_time < '2026-02-08'
group by 1
order by credits desc

name: Docs search — top queries
description: Most common docs searches and zero-result rate (last 30d).

native.query:
select s.query,
       count(*) as searches,
       sum(case when s.results_count=0 then 1 else 0 end)::float / count(*) as zero_result_rate
from docs_search_events s
where s.occurred_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
group by 1
having count(*) >= 25
order by searches desc
limit 50
